name: Mobility
strategy: Gain positional advantages through movement, evasion, and battlefield maneuvering.

commands.name: Flanking Run
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +3" Move and ignores the first 2" of Difficult Terrain during its next normal Move this Round.

commands.name: Mobile Fire Support
commands.effect: One friendly Unit may use a Heavy ranged Attack after moving during the preceding Movement Phase, worsening Hit by one step. Applies to its next eligible ranged Attack this Round.

commands.name: Rapid Footwork
commands.effect: One unengaged friendly Unit may immediately Move up to 2", ending legally and unengaged.

commands.name: Evasive Shift
commands.effect: One unengaged friendly Unit immediately resolves Blink 2.

commands.name: Pathfinders
commands.effect: One friendly Unit ignores Difficult Terrain penalties on its next normal Move this Round and gains Tough 1 against its next ranged Attack this Round.

doctrineIdentity: Independent maneuverability and flexible positioning. Mobility improves movement without generally making Charges more damaging.
